I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread: "Noted, Hollis. Expense reports are due Friday (Oct 16). If you'd like, I can put a reminder on your calendar for Thursday."

I didn't look anything up or set up a reminder. I got the Oct 16 date by counting from the message's own date (Wednesday, Oct 14), not from the system clock. The calendar reminder is only offered and will wait for Hollis to say yes.
